topics.topic: Accepted `api_base_url` formats and the exact URL-join behavior for each format
questions: What exact `api_base_url` forms are valid (userinfo, query, fragment, existing path), and how must joining behave for those forms?

topics.topic: Behavior when a selected service has no credential reference configured (startup rejection vs per-send runtime failure)
questions: If a selected service has no configured credential reference at all (not just resolution failure), is startup refused, or does each send fail at runtime as `operation_failed`?

topics.topic: Canonical pre-hash JSON schema for `request_digest` description so implementations produce identical digests
questions: What exact JSON structure (field names, nesting, list-vs-object choices) must be used for the "description" before canonicalization, so different implementations compute the same request_digest?

topics.topic: Exact node/edge set used in A05 phase-7 cycle detection, including whether guard relations participate
questions: Exactly which vertices are in the cycle graph for this check (only flow nodes, or flow inputs/outputs as well), and are guard relations part of it?

topics.topic: Exact placeholder grammar in A09 paths and when malformed forms must be rejected
questions: What is the exact grammar for recognizing placeholders in paths (escaping, unmatched braces, repeated braces, literal braces), and which malformed forms are refused at proposal time versus send time?

topics.topic: How MCP request-size limits are measured (payload-only vs including transport framing/envelope)
questions: For MCP transport, does size include framing/envelope bytes or only the decoded operation payload bytes?

topics.topic: How `stored_value_bytes_max` applies to `many` inputs (per-element, whole array, or both)
questions: For a `many` value input, is `stored_value_bytes_max` applied to the whole array value, to each element, or both?

topics.topic: How strictly K-02 determinism bans (time/randomness) are enforced when sources exist in runtime but are not yet on the trap list
questions: If a time/random source exists in the shipped Python runtime but is not in the trapped list, must using it still fail now, or is it allowed until a later release updates the trap list?

topics.topic: Meaning of 'reaches' in A05 phase-9 (pure structural reachability vs runtime-feasible paths)
questions: Does "reaches" mean structural reachability regardless of whether guard conditions are actually satisfiable at runtime, or only potentially deliverable paths?

topics.topic: Required `started_at`/`ended_at` values for NodeExecution records where no execution occurs
questions: For records where no execution actually runs (`skipped_by_guard`, `upstream_failed`, owner refusal), what values must `started_at` and `ended_at` take, and must they be equal?

topics.topic: Validation behavior for malformed-but-present manifest data: failure details and check ordering
questions: For malformed but present manifest structures (wrong JSON types, malformed capability items, missing nested fields used later), what exact failure detail and check order apply?

topics.topic: Whether user function code may access the sandbox filesystem (exchange directory) or all filesystem access is forbidden
questions: Should function code be allowed to read/write files in the sandbox exchange directory, or should any filesystem access by user code be treated as a sandbox violation to match K-02?
